alt: Interior of AT&T Stadium in Arlington Texas glowing bright magenta-pink from rows of LED grow lights on suspended trusses above the soccer field, with the stands and giant video screens visible in the pink-lit darkness
story: For the 2026 FIFA World Cup, AT&T Stadium hung 18 massive LED rigs from its ceiling and bathed the entire interior in magenta-pink light for months — because the retractable roof that makes the arena weather-proof also blocks the sunlight FIFA requires natural grass to have.
why_funny: A $1.2 billion NFL stadium needed a full-scale indoor farm installation because the architects never considered that football grass and World Cup grass have one thing in common: they both need the sun.
